headline: Flutter Entertainment Stock Slips on Q3 Revenue Miss
summary: Flutter Entertainment shares slipped following its third-quarter earnings report after missing analyst revenue estimates.
why: Flutter Entertainment is a leading global online betting and gaming operator, making its revenue performance a key indicator for the consumer discretionary gaming sector.

impacts.name: Flutter Entertainment
impacts.why: A revenue miss relative to expectations negatively impacts share price valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
